# Synthetic SHX fixtures (legal, minimal)

Minimal AutoCAD SHX 1.0 / bigfont 1.0 binaries generated by `generate-fixtures.mjs`.
Used for P8 glyph-coverage audits when proprietary customer fonts are not in storage.

Regenerate:

```bash
node tests/fixtures/cad/synthetic-shx/generate-fixtures.mjs
```

Dev API: `/api/dev/pf-cad-fixture?source=font&name=MIRYL.SHX`
